prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (spray vs UV beds, budget, distance, extras). I don’t have live local-search access, so I can’t pull current ratings — but I can help find the right salon for you. Quick questions:
- Do you want a spray (sunless) tan or a UV bed tan?
- What neighborhood or ZIP code in Columbus?
- Any other priorities (price, membership, luxury, quick walk‑in)?

How to pick the best local salon
- Read recent reviews (Google, Yelp): look for consistency, photos, and responses to complaints.
- Cleanliness & professionalism: salons that respond to reviews and keep booths and common areas tidy are better.
- Equipment & products: newer high-pressure beds and professional spray machines/solutions give more even results.
- Staff skill: ask for before/after photos, patch tests for spray tans, and training/certification for technicians.
- Pricing & membership: compare single sessions vs packages and check for enrollment fees or blackout rules.
- Safety: trained staff should provide protective eyewear and guidance on session frequency.

Safety tips
- Consider sunless (spray) tanning to avoid UV risks.
- If using UV beds: limit sessions, follow recommended exposure, use goggles, and check with a doctor if you’re on photosensitizing meds.
- Exfoliate before a spray tan and hydrate afterwards for even fading.

If you tell me your ZIP or neighborhood and whether you prefer spray or UV, I’ll give tailored suggestions and typical places to check in Columbus.
